title: Enderman Chaos
description: This Minecraft data pack that's for 1.21.8+ allows enderman to pick up all blocks not including air.
body:
This minecraft datapack allows enderman to pick up all minecraft blocks instead of just grass blocks and some others. This datapack was made because I was bored but I might update it.
